verses.translation: Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

translations.ron: Ascultaţi cuvântul Domnului, voi, copii ai lui Israel, că Domnul stă la judecată cu locuitorii pământului,
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατε λόγον Κυρίου υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, ὅτι κρίσις τῷ Κυρίῳ πρὸς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν, διότι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια, οὐδὲ ἔλεος, οὐδὲ ἐπίγνωσις Θεοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.translation: Cursing, and lying, and murder, and theft, and adultery abound in the land, and they mingle blood with blood.

translations.ron: Că nu mai este credinţă, nici iubire, nici cunoaştere de Dumnezeu în ţară.
translations.grk: Ἀρὰ, καὶ ψεῦδος, καὶ φόνος καὶ κλοπὴ, καὶ μοιχεία κέχυται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ αἵματα ἐφʼ αἵμασι μίσγουσι.

verses.translation: Therefore shall the land mourn, and shall be diminished with all that dwell in it, with the wild beasts of the field, and the reptiles of the earth, and with the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea shall fail:

translations.ron: Toţi jură strâmb, mint, ucid, fură şi sunt desfrânaţi; săvârşesc fapte silnice, iar sângele vărsat curge peste sânge.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο πενθήσει ἡ γῆ, καὶ σμικρυνθήσεται σὺν πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτὴν, σὺν τοῖς θηρίοις τοῦ ἀγροῦ, καὶ σὺν τοῖς ἑρπετοῖς τῆς γῆς, καὶ σὺν τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ οἱ ἰχθύες τῆς θαλάσσης ἐκλείψουσιν,

verses.translation: that neither any one may plead, nor any one reprove another: but my people are as a priest spoken against.

translations.ron: Pentru aceasta ţara e în mare jale, iar cei ce o locuiesc sunt fără vlagă.
translations.grk: ὅπως μηδεὶς μήτε δικάζηται, μήτε ἐλέγχῃ μηδείς· ὁ δὲ λαός μου ὡς ἀντιλεγόμενος ἱερεύς.

verses.translation: Therefore they shall fall by day, and the prophet with thee shall fall: I have compared thy mother unto night.

translations.ron: Tu te poticneşti ziua, iar noaptea se poticneşte cu tine şi profetul şi voi face să piară poporul tău.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀσθενήσει ἡμέρας, καὶ ἀσθενήσει ὁ προφήτης μετὰ σοῦ· νυκτὶ ὡμοίωσα τὴν μητέρα σου.

verses.translation: My people are like as if they had no knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt not minister as priest to me: and as thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I also will forget thy children.

translations.ron: Poporul Meu va pieri, pentru că nu mai cunoaşte pe Domnul. Şi pentru că tu ai trecut cu vederea cunoaşterea Domnului, Eu te voi da la o parte din preoţia Mea. Şi fiindcă tu ai uitat de legea Domnului, şi Eu voi uita pe fiii tăi.
translations.grk: Ὡμοιώθη ὁ λαός μου, ὡς οὐκ ἔχων γνῶσιν· ὅτι σὺ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀπώσω, κᾀγὼ ἀπώσομαί σε, τοῦμὴ ἱερατεύειν μοι· καὶ ἐπελάθου νόμον Θεοῦ σου, κᾀγὼ ἐπιλήσομαι τέκνων σου.

verses.translation: According to their multitude, so they sinned against me: I will turn their glory into shame.

translations.ron: Cu cât s-au înmulţit, cu atât au păcătuit împotriva Mea; cinstea lor au schimbat-o în ruşine.
translations.grk: Κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν, οὕτως ἥμαρτόν μοι· τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν εἰς ἀτιμίαν θήσομαι.

verses.translation: They will devour the sins of my people, and will set their hearts on their iniquities.

translations.ron: Ei se hrănesc din fărădelegile poporului Meu, şi năzuinţa lor este numai către păcat.
translations.grk: Ἁμαρτίας λαοῦ μου φάγονται· καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν λήψονται τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And the priest shall be as the people: and I will avenge on them their ways, and I will recompense to them their counsels.

translations.ron: Dar şi poporului i se va întâmpla ca şi preotului; voi pedepsi purtarea lui, iar faptele lui le voi întoarce împotriva lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται καθὼς ὁ λαὸς, οὕτως καὶ ὁ ἱερεύς· καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ διαβούλια αὐτοῦ ἀνταποδώσω αὐτῷ.

verses.translation: And they shall eat, and shall not be satisfied: they have gone a-whoring, and shall by no means prosper: because they have left off to take heed to the Lord.

translations.ron: Vor mânca, dar nu se vor sătura. Când se vor desfrâna, nu se vor înmulţi, că au părăsit pe Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ φάγονται, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐμπλησθῶσιν· ἐπόρνευσαν, καὶ οὐ μὴ κατευθύνωσι· διότι τὸν Κύριον ἐγκατέλιπον τοῦ φυλάξαι.

verses.translation: The heart of my people has gladly engaged in fornication and wine and strong drink.

translations.ron: Desfrânarea, vinul şi mustul dau curaj inimii.
translations.grk: Πορνείαν καὶ οἶνον καὶ μέθυσμα ἐδέξατο καρδία λαοῦ μου·

verses.translation: They asked counsel by means of signs, and they reported answer to them by their staves: they have gone astray in a spirit of whoredom, and gone grievously a-whoring from their God.

translations.ron: Poporul Meu întreabă o bucată de lemn şi toiagul lui îi vesteşte viitorul, că un duh de desfrânare i-a făcut să rătăcească şi au săvârşit destrăbălări, depărtându-se de Dumnezeul lor;
translations.grk: ἐν συμβόλοις ἐπηρώτων, καὶ ἐν ῥάβδοις αὐτοῦ ἀπήγγελλον αὐτῷ· πνεύματι πορνείας ἐπλανήθησαν, καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσαν ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: They have sacrificed on the tops of the mountains, and on the hills they have sacrificed under the oak and poplar, and under the shady tree, because the shade was good: therefore your daughters shall go a-whoring, and your daughters-in-law shall commit adultery.

translations.ron: Ei aduc jertfe pe vârfurile munţilor şi tămâieri pe înălţimea colinelor, sub stejari, plopi şi terebinţi, căci umbra este bună. Iar dacă fiicele voastre se desfrânează şi nurorile voastre sunt prea desfrânate,
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ τὰς κορυφὰς τῶν ὀρέων ἐθυσίαζον, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς βουνοὺς ἔθυον ὑποκάτω δρυὸς, καὶ λεύκης, καὶ δένδρου συσκιάζοντος, ὅτι καλὸν σκέπη. διὰ τοῦτο ἐκπορνεύσουσιν αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν, καὶ αἱ νύμφαι ὑμῶν μοιχεύσουσι.

verses.translation: And I will not visit upon your daughters when they shall commit fornication, nor your daughters-in-law when they shall commit adultery: for they themselves mingled themselves with harlots, and sacrificed with polluted ones, and the people that understood not entangled itself with a harlot.

translations.ron: Nu voi pedepsi pe fetele voastre fiindcă au fost ticăloase şi nici pe nurorile voastre că s-au desfrânat, că ele înseşi merg laolaltă cu desfrânatele şi aduc jertfă la un loc cu ticăloasele, astfel că poporul Meu merge la pieirea lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐπισκέψωμαι ἐπὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν ὅταν πορνεύσωσι, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς νύμφας ὑμῶν ὅταν μοιχεύωσιν· ὅτι αὐτοὶ μετὰ τῶν πορνῶν συνεφύροντο, καὶ μετὰ τῶν τετελεσμένων ἔθυον, καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ μὴ συνιὼν συνεπλέκετο μετὰ πόρνης.

verses.translation: But thou, Israel, be not ignorant, and go ye not, men of Juda, to Galgala; and go not up to the house of On, and swear not by the living Lord.

translations.ron: Dacă te desfrânezi, o, Israele, Iuda să nu mai păcătuiască. Nu mai veniţi la Ghilgal şi nu vă mai suiţi în Bet-Aven şi nu vă juraţi: "Viu este Domnul!"
translations.grk: Σὺ δὲ Ἰσραὴλ μὴ ἀγνόει, καὶ Ἰούδα μὴ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς Γάλγαλα, καὶ μὴ ἀναβαίνετε εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ὦν, καὶ μὴ ὀμνύετε ζῶντα Κύριον.

verses.translation: For Israel was maddened like a mad heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a wide place.

translations.ron: Că asemenea junincei îndărătnice, aşa şi Israel s-a îndărătnicit. Şi să-i mai pască pe ei Domnul ca pe un miel în păşuni întinse?
translations.grk: Διότι ὡς δάμαλις παροιστρῶσα παροίστρησεν Ἰσραήλ· νῦν νεμήσει αὐτοὺς Κύριος ὡς ἀμνὸν ἐν εὐρυχώρῳ.

verses.translation: Ephraim, joined with idols, has laid stumbling-blocks in his own way.

translations.ron: Efraim este alipit de idoli; lasă-l!...
translations.grk: Μέτοχος εἰδώλων Ἐφραὶμ ἔθηκεν ἑαυτῷ σκάνδαλα,

verses.translation: He has chosen the Chananites: they have grievously gone a-whoring: they have loved dishonour through her insolence.

translations.ron: După ce isprăvesc de băut, se dedau desfrâului; iar mai-marii lor năzuiesc numai către fapte de ruşine.
translations.grk: ἠρέτισε Χαναναίους· πορνεύοντες ἐξεπόρνευσαν, ἠγάπησαν ἀτιμίαν ἐκ φρυάγματος αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Thou art a blast of wind in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their altars.

translations.ron: Vântui îi va strânge în aripile sale şi ruşinea îi va cuprinde din pricina jertfelor lor.
translations.grk: Συστροφὴ πνεύματος σὺ εἶ ἐν ταῖς πτέρυξιν αὐτῆς, καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται ἐκ τῶν θυσιαστηρίων αὐτῶν.
